summary: Yahweh speaks to Moses speak to Aaron and sons: You shall bless children of Israel saying Yahweh bless you and keep you, Yahweh make his face shine upon you and be gracious to you, Yahweh lift up his face upon you and give you peace. So shall you put my name upon children of Israel and I will bless them. Also law of Nazirite who separates to Yahweh — leave grape, razor not come upon head, not go near dead body, if dies suddenly shave, bring offerings.
whyItMatters: Aaronic blessing — most famous benediction in Bible, used in Jewish and Christian liturgy. Threefold Yahweh name, sixfold blessing. Also Nazirite vow shows consecration beyond priesthood.

context.author: Traditionally Moses; modern scholars debate the book's final form

keyVerses.text: ‘Yahweh bless you, and keep you. Yahweh make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you. Yahweh lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’
keyVerses.why: Threefold blessing — bless keep, face shine gracious, lift face give peace.

questions.question: What does Aaronic blessing mean line by line?
questions.answer: Three lines with Yahweh name each (triple). Line1: Yahweh bless you and keep you — bless = kneel to give, keep = guard, protect. Line2: Yahweh make his face shine upon you and be gracious — face shine = smile, favor, light, gracious = give favor as gift. Line3: Yahweh lift up his face upon you and give you peace — lift face = lift up countenance to look, give attention, give shalom wholeness. So shall you put my name upon Israel and I will bless — name placed on people like seal, they bear divine name, then God blesses. Used as benediction.

questions.question: What is Nazirite vow?
questions.answer: Nazir (separated) who separates to Yahweh: vow, no wine nor strong drink, not eat grapes, no razor upon head all days of separation (hair grows as sign), not go near dead body even father mother (stricter than priest), defilement if sudden death — shave and restart. At end brings offerings: lamb burnt, ewe sin, ram peace, basket unleavened, priest waves, then may drink wine. Examples: Samson (from birth), Samuel (a Nazirite-style vow from his mother), John Baptist perhaps. Temporary or lifelong consecration beyond ordinary — any can be set apart like priest for period.

glossary.def: Threefold priestly benediction: bless keep, face shine gracious, lift face give peace.
Smile, favor, attention — face shining as lamp, lifted as noticing.
Separated one — vow no grape, no razor, no dead — consecrated like priest temporarily.
